answer.text:
According to Adobe Inc.'s Consolidated Statements of Income for the fiscal year ended November 29, 2024 (accession: `0000796343-25-000004`, section: `CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME`, chunk ID: `c8e23789-3e5b-5998-a527-7bb13e5d5a92`):

- **Total revenue:** $21,505 million
- **Gross profit:** $19,147 million

### Calculation:
$$\text{Gross Profit Margin} = \frac{\text{Gross Profit}}{\text{Total Revenue}} \times 100$$

$$\text{Gross Profit Margin} = \frac{\$19,147\text{ million}}{\$21,505\text{ million}} \times 100 \approx 89.0351\% \text{ (or } 89.04\%)$$

*(Note: In Note 2 (Revenue) of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements, chunk ID: `b8fa3362-a910-51b7-aebe-a44fa81085a4`, "Gross profit as a percentage of revenue" is also reported as rounded to **89%**).*
